native_ieee_model.binding: Cfloat f32/f64 are Why3 ieee_float.Float32/64; arithmetic operators are native IEEE RNE; sign uses is_negative, not numeric x<0. FloatConverter casts preserve NaN/infinity/signed zero. Drivers import native standard SMT floating-point support.
native_ieee_model.control_scope: 10 correct plus 3 deliberately wrong/impossible postconditions behave as recorded; not a universal frontend correctness theorem.

qualifications.detail: same_value is numerical FP equality or both NaN: final outputs may differ in zero sign/NaN payload/FP flags. This must not be described as bitwise equality or arbitrary-context equivalence.

same_float DOES preserve sign for every non-NaN, including +/-0, while identifying NaNs. Keep it for loads/stores/transport and congruence premises. same_value alone is insufficient for substitution into division: 1/+0 and 1/-0 yield infinities of different sign. Intermediate arithmetic contracts returning only same_value may need stronger proved postconditions before reuse in sign-sensitive compositions.
min/max raw llvm-diff exited1 and remains preserved. Byte-identical IR independently verifies the narrower same-host compilation identity; do not claim llvm-diff itself passed.

min/max RVV target is the earlier repaired NaN-propagating version, equal byte-for-byte to the old frozen target; original pre-repair target remains separately preserved. The claim is not original buggy-target equivalence.
v7 sub explicitly checks test_neon/test_rvv bodies; v2 min/max checks their inlined bodies inside equivalent. Do not apply the v7 coverage expectation mechanically to v2 reports.
